title: MS Paint and Photos inivisibly watermark even locally generated output with GUID

title: Show HN: PicoMQ – Durable Streams over HTTP, on object storage
text:
PicoMQ is a Rust server for Durable Streams, built on Object Store. Cheap, URL-addressable, granular streams (create/append/read/long-poll/SSE), with Pico Protocol or Durable Streams Protocol as the facade.

S3Stream is the stream storage primitive, used in AutoMQ, shipped as a Rust library. Coordination is a command log in Postgres.
summary: PicoMQ是一个基于对象存储的Rust服务器，提供低成本、URL可寻址的持久化流，支持长轮询和SSE，并可作为AutoMQ的S3Stream存储原语。看点在于用Postgres命令日志协调，实现廉价且细粒度的流式数据管理。

title: Show HN: Kern – container and resource runtime in a 1.5 MB binary, no daemon
text: I built kern because I needed a fast, zero-daemon tool to set CPU/RAM limits and run isolated tasks without the overhead of Docker. It's a single 1.5MB Rust binary using OCI images, cgroup v2, and namespaces. Boxes start in ~3.5ms. It's not a Kubernetes CRI or a microVM, just a standalone container and resource runtime for CLI and agents.
summary: Kern是一个仅1.5MB的Rust单二进制容器运行时，无需守护进程，利用cgroup v2和命名空间实现约3.5ms的极速启动，适合CLI和代理场景，但非Kubernetes CRI或微VM。

title: Executable Is a SQLite Database
summary: 该帖介绍了一种将可执行文件本身作为SQLite数据库存储和查询的创新方法，通过把程序代码与数据融合进同一文件，实现自描述和可检索的二进制格式。看点在于颠覆传统可执行文件结构，为软件分发、审计和动态分析提供新思路。
